Our approach

Train withpurpose.

Vibe Fitness is a premium gym in Gulberg Green Residencia, built around a simple idea: a modern, well-equipped space where showing up consistently feels natural.

Spacious workout zones, certified trainers and a body assessment to understand your starting point, plus a free daily locker, shower and towel, so the only thing left to bring is the effort.

        Legal

        Privacy Policy

        Last updated: October 2026

        This policy explains how Vibe Fitness (“we”) handles the information you share through the enquiry form on this website.

        What we collect

        If you use the enquiry form, we collect the details you type in: your name, phone number, optional email address, the option you are interested in, and an optional message.

        How we use it

        • To reply to your enquiry about memberships, day passes or visits.
        • To answer follow-up questions you ask us.

        We do not sell your information and we do not use it for unrelated marketing.

        Storage and sharing

        Enquiries are passed to the Vibe Fitness team and kept only as long as needed to handle your request. We share details only with service providers needed to deliver the enquiry, or where the law requires it.

        Cookies and tracking

        This website does not set advertising cookies. If analytics are added in future, this policy will be updated.

        Your choices

        You can ask us to correct or delete your enquiry details at any time by calling 0309 9555313 or messaging us on Instagram.

        This is a plain-language policy for a small business website and is not legal advice. Please have it reviewed before relying on it.

        Terms of Use

        Last updated: October 2026

        By using this website you agree to these basic terms.

        Information on this site

        We aim to keep prices, opening hours and offers accurate, but they can change. Please confirm current pricing and availability with the team before visiting. Nothing on this website is a binding offer.

        Enquiries, not bookings or payments

        The enquiry form sends us a request for information. It does not reserve a place or process a payment. Memberships are agreed with the Vibe Fitness team in person.

        Health

        Exercise carries some risk. If you have a medical condition or concerns, speak with a doctor before you begin training.
